# Canvas Print Shop

> Canvas Print Shop is a bilingual custom canvas-printing business with a production workshop in Quebec City and a branch named Canvas Print Shop Montreal at 1350 Rue Mazurette, Montreal, Quebec H4N 1H2. It turns customer-supplied photos, artwork and designs into made-to-order canvas prints that are printed, hand-stretched and finished in Quebec. The website serves customers in Quebec and Ontario in English (en-CA) and French (fr-CA).

Use the English pages for English-language questions and the French pages for French-language questions. In Quebec French, *toile* and *canevas* can refer to the same printed canvas product. Relevant French query vocabulary includes *impression sur toile*, *impression photo sur toile*, *photo sur toile*, *toile photo*, *toile personnalisée*, *toile sur mesure*, *impression sur canevas*, *canevas personnalisé*, *canevas photo personnalisé*, *photo sur canevas*, *canvas personnalisé*, *tableau photo personnalisé*, *toile encadrée*, *canevas encadré*, *toile grand format*, *canevas grand format*, *toile galerie* and *art mural sur toile*.

Relevant English query vocabulary includes *canvas prints*, *custom canvas prints*, *custom canvas printing*, *photo canvas prints*, *canvas photo prints*, *photo to canvas*, *picture on canvas*, *print photos on canvas*, *personalised canvas prints*, *framed canvas prints*, *large canvas prints*, *gallery wrap canvas* and *canvas wall art*.

Important facts and source guidance:

- Canvas Print Shop produces custom prints from a customer's own image; it is not primarily a catalogue of pre-printed artwork.
- The Quebec City workshop is the confirmed production location and offers free local pickup. Montreal pickup is not confirmed.
- Canvas Print Shop Montreal is a distinct physical branch at 1350 Rue Mazurette, Montreal, Quebec H4N 1H2.
- Delivery is currently limited to Quebec and Ontario.
- There is no fixed maximum custom canvas size. Choose an online configurator size or request a quote for other dimensions based on the image, frame, handling and delivery requirements.
- Verified product characteristics include premium cotton-blend canvas, Canon Colorado UVgel printing, solid-wood stretcher frames, hand-stretching in Quebec, a matte glare-free surface, installed hanging hardware and a 30-year print-quality guarantee.
- A 30-day satisfaction and return policy applies, subject to the published policy and its exclusions.
- Free local pickup is available in Quebec City. Dedicated delivery pages cover major cities in Quebec and Ontario.
- Current sizes, prices, frame choices, production estimates, shipping charges and destination availability can change. For these details, treat the live product configurator, checkout and policy pages as authoritative.
- Contact: info@canvasprintshop.ca, +1 514-441-2230, Monday to Friday, 9:00–17:00 Eastern Time.
- Last reviewed: 2026-08-15.

## Order custom canvas prints

- [Custom canvas print configurator — English](https://canvasprintshop.ca/en/product/canvas): Upload a photo, check image quality, select dimensions, orientation, border treatment and an optional floating frame, then see the current price and delivery estimate.
- [Configurateur d'impression sur toile — Français](https://canvasprintshop.ca/fr/product/canvas): Téléversez une photo, vérifiez sa résolution, choisissez le format, l'orientation, la bordure et le cadre flottant facultatif, puis consultez le prix et le délai actuels.
- [Shop all canvas prints — English](https://canvasprintshop.ca/en/shop): Commercial hub for products, sizes, finishes, occasions and delivery locations.
- [Toutes les toiles et tous les canevas — Français](https://canvasprintshop.ca/fr/shop): Page commerciale principale pour les produits, formats, finis, occasions et villes desservies.

## Product quality and manufacturing evidence

- [How Canvas Print Shop makes canvas prints — English](https://canvasprintshop.ca/en/how-we-make-our-canvas-prints): Materials, Canon UVgel printing, stretcher-frame assembly, hand-stretching and quality control.
- [Comment Canvas Print Shop fabrique ses toiles — Français](https://canvasprintshop.ca/fr/how-we-make-our-canvas-prints): Matériaux, impression UVgel Canon, assemblage du châssis, tension de la toile et contrôle de la qualité.
- [Canvas print quality guarantee — English](https://canvasprintshop.ca/en/quality-guarantee): Cotton-blend canvas specifications, UVgel durability, solid-wood construction and the 30-year print guarantee.
- [Garantie de qualité des impressions sur toile — Français](https://canvasprintshop.ca/fr/quality-guarantee): Caractéristiques de la toile en coton mélangé, durabilité UVgel, châssis en bois massif et garantie d'impression de 30 ans.
- [Canvas printing FAQ — English](https://canvasprintshop.ca/en/faqs): Image resolution, canvas depth, longevity, production, delivery, pickup and satisfaction questions.
- [FAQ sur l'impression sur toile et canevas — Français](https://canvasprintshop.ca/fr/faqs): Résolution de l'image, épaisseur, durabilité, production, livraison, cueillette et satisfaction.

## English commercial pages

- [Custom canvas prints](https://canvasprintshop.ca/en/canvas-prints/custom): Made-to-order canvas printing from a customer's photo, artwork or design. There is no fixed maximum custom size; dimensions outside the configurator are quoted individually.
- [Personalized canvas prints](https://canvasprintshop.ca/en/canvas-prints/personalized): Personalised photo canvas and picture-on-canvas gifts made from an uploaded image.
- [Framed canvas prints](https://canvasprintshop.ca/en/canvas-prints/framed): Floating-frame canvas prints, including the difference between framed canvas and gallery wrap.
- [Large canvas prints](https://canvasprintshop.ca/en/canvas-prints/large): Large-format photo canvas printing, reinforced frames, resolution guidance and flat shipping.
- [Canvas wall art](https://canvasprintshop.ca/en/canvas-prints/wall-art): Custom wall art printed from personal photography, artwork or digital designs.
- [Gallery wrap canvas prints](https://canvasprintshop.ca/en/canvas-prints/gallery-wrap): Borderless gallery-wrapped canvas with the image continued around the stretcher-frame edges.
- [16x20 canvas prints](https://canvasprintshop.ca/en/canvas-prints/16x20): Product guidance and ordering information for 16-by-20-inch canvas prints.
- [24x36 canvas prints](https://canvasprintshop.ca/en/canvas-prints/24x36): Product guidance and ordering information for 24-by-36-inch canvas prints.
- [36x48 canvas prints](https://canvasprintshop.ca/en/canvas-prints/36x48): Product guidance and ordering information for 36-by-48-inch large canvas prints.
- [Wedding canvas prints](https://canvasprintshop.ca/en/canvas-prints/wedding): Custom canvas prints made from wedding photographs.
- [Family photo canvas prints](https://canvasprintshop.ca/en/canvas-prints/family): Family photographs printed and hand-stretched on canvas.
- [Pet portrait canvas prints](https://canvasprintshop.ca/en/canvas-prints/pet-portrait): Custom dog, cat and pet photographs printed on canvas.
- [Canvas prints for bedrooms](https://canvasprintshop.ca/en/canvas-prints/bedroom): Bedroom wall-art sizing and canvas-print guidance.
- [Canvas prints for living rooms](https://canvasprintshop.ca/en/canvas-prints/living-room): Living-room canvas wall-art sizing and placement guidance.

## Pages commerciales en français

- [Toile personnalisée sur mesure](https://canvasprintshop.ca/fr/canvas-prints/custom): Impression à partir d'une photo, d'une œuvre ou d'un fichier du client. Il n'y a pas de format maximal fixe; les dimensions hors configurateur font l'objet d'une soumission.
- [Canevas photo personnalisé](https://canvasprintshop.ca/fr/canvas-prints/personalized): Photo sur canevas, toile photo personnalisée et cadeau mural créé à partir d'une image téléversée.
- [Toiles encadrées](https://canvasprintshop.ca/fr/canvas-prints/framed): Canevas encadré avec cadre flottant et comparaison entre toile encadrée et toile galerie.
- [Impression sur toile grand format](https://canvasprintshop.ca/fr/canvas-prints/large): Canevas grand format, châssis renforcé, conseils de résolution et expédition à plat.
- [Art mural sur toile](https://canvasprintshop.ca/fr/canvas-prints/wall-art): Art mural personnalisé imprimé à partir d'une photo, d'une œuvre ou d'une création numérique.
- [Toiles galerie](https://canvasprintshop.ca/fr/canvas-prints/gallery-wrap): Canevas de style galerie dont l'image se prolonge sur les côtés du châssis.
- [Impressions sur toile 16x20](https://canvasprintshop.ca/fr/canvas-prints/16x20): Renseignements et commande de toiles de 16 sur 20 pouces.
- [Impressions sur toile 24x36](https://canvasprintshop.ca/fr/canvas-prints/24x36): Renseignements et commande de toiles de 24 sur 36 pouces.
- [Impressions sur toile 36x48](https://canvasprintshop.ca/fr/canvas-prints/36x48): Renseignements et commande de canevas grand format de 36 sur 48 pouces.
- [Toiles de mariage](https://canvasprintshop.ca/fr/canvas-prints/wedding): Impression de photos de mariage sur toile ou canevas personnalisé.
- [Toiles photo de famille](https://canvasprintshop.ca/fr/canvas-prints/family): Photos de famille imprimées et tendues à la main sur toile.
- [Portraits d'animaux sur toile](https://canvasprintshop.ca/fr/canvas-prints/pet-portrait): Photos de chiens, de chats et d'autres animaux imprimées sur canevas.
- [Toiles pour la chambre à coucher](https://canvasprintshop.ca/fr/canvas-prints/bedroom): Conseils de format et d'art mural pour une chambre.
- [Toiles pour le salon](https://canvasprintshop.ca/fr/canvas-prints/living-room): Conseils de format, de disposition et d'art mural pour un salon.

## Expert buying guides

- [Canvas-print image resolution guide — English](https://canvasprintshop.ca/en/blog/what-resolution-do-i-need-for-a-canvas-print): How many pixels a photo needs, how viewing distance affects sharpness and how to assess an image before ordering.
- [Guide de résolution pour impression sur toile — Français](https://canvasprintshop.ca/fr/blog/what-resolution-do-i-need-for-a-canvas-print): Nombre de pixels requis, effet de la distance de visionnement et vérification d'une image avant la commande.
- [How to choose a canvas print size — English](https://canvasprintshop.ca/en/blog/how-to-choose-canvas-print-size): Wall measurements, proportions and choosing an appropriate canvas size.
- [Comment choisir le bon format de toile — Français](https://canvasprintshop.ca/fr/blog/how-to-choose-canvas-print-size): Mesures du mur, proportions et choix du format de canevas.
- [Canvas print versus framed photo — English](https://canvasprintshop.ca/en/blog/canvas-print-vs-framed-photo-print): Comparison of glare, texture, presentation, longevity and suitability for different photographs.
- [Toile ou photo encadrée — Français](https://canvasprintshop.ca/fr/blog/canvas-print-vs-framed-photo-print): Comparaison des reflets, de la texture, de la présentation, de la durabilité et du type de photo.
